note: The Gambia, read on 2026-11-03 in the Gambia Immigration Department's own page on residential permits (gid.gov.gm sends an incomplete certificate chain that wasn't bypassed, so it was read in Common Crawl's capture of 14 October 2026), and on 2026-10-30 and again 2026-11-03 in FactCheck Gambia's explainer (27 August 2024, quoting section 10(2) of the Immigration Act 1965 as amended in 2004) and The Point's report of the 2023 budget speech. The Department issues two types: Permit A to one who intends to reside without gainful employment, usually students and retired people (the means route, allowing no work), and Permit B to those who intend to live, reside and work, businesspersons, expatriates, unskilled workers and other professionals (a work route; whether it ties its holder to an employer isn't said, so `work` is left out). The explainer's third type, Permit C for unskilled workers, isn't on the Department's page, which puts unskilled workers under B: it was written until 2026-11-03 and is removed. 'Residential permits are renewed annually' (the explainer): written as a one-year term, renewable; the Department's page names renewals but not the term. The Department's fees are D3,100 (A) and D3,600 (B) for ECOWAS citizens and D5,700 (A) and D7,700 (B) for others, the latter including the Alien Card's D2,500; the form holds one fee for a route, and nothing in it says who is an ECOWAS citizen, so no fee is written. An ECOWAS citizen may have a permit only after 90 days' stay and others after 56, so the permit is had in the Gambia; where it is applied for isn't said, so `apply` is left out. Nothing is said of decision times, permanent residence or naturalisation's years.

sources.title: FactCheck Gambia, EXPLAINER: How to Acquire a Residence Permit in Gambia (27 August 2024)
sources.said: According to section 10 (2) of the Immigration Act, 1965 (amended in 2004), a residential permit issued to an individual shall indicate whether the permit is for residence only or for residence and employment. However, the issueance of a residence only permit is subject to the fact that one has sufficient means to live in The Gambia without gainful employment. ... there are 3 categories of residential permits issued by The Gambia Immigration Department. These include types A, B, and C: ... Is is for residence purpose only and it is issued mainly to retired foreign citizens and international students. ... Is for residence and employment purposes. Citizens of the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) and other foreign nationals who are skilled workers are issued with this type of residence permit. ... This residential permit is also for employment purposes and is issued to unskilled workers, especially those from ECOWAS member states. ... However, citizens of Mauritania, the Republic of Guinea, Mali, and Senegal are exempted by law from paying for the resident permit. ... Residential permits are renewed annually.

sources.title: Gambia Immigration Department, Residential Permit (Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-43 capture of 2026-10-14, WARC CC-MAIN-20261014154306-20261014184306-00526, offset 209195347)
sources.said: The nature of our resident permit is biometric and the types are ECOWAS and Non-ECOWAS permits. ... Types Of Permits Resident Permit A This type of permit is issued upon prescribed application to the Director General by an applicant declaring that he or she intends to reside in the Gambia but without venturing into any forms of gainful employment. This permit type is usually issued to foreign student residing in the Gambia, retire... Resident Permit B This type of permit is issued to persons who intend, upon admission, to live, reside and work in the Gambia. As such it is issued, upon application and approval to businesspersons, expatriates, unskilled workers and other professionals who get paid for livelihood. ... Prior year Residential Permit (for renewals only) Prescribed Non-Refundable Fees The prescribed fees, subjected to changes, for Residence Permit A/B, Alien Card and Non-Gambian ID Card are as follows: Residential Permit A (ECOWAS) = D3100 Residential Permit B (ECOWAS) = D3600 Residential Permit A (Non-ECOWAS) = D5700 (D2500 for the Alien Card) Residential Permit B (Non-ECOWAS) = D7700 (D2500 for the Alien Card) Non-Gambian ID Card = D750
